en: A single pulley changes the direction of a force, but adding a second pulley actually halves the physical effort needed to lift a heavy object.
Ice is slippery not just because it is smooth, but because friction from your skates melts a microscopic layer of liquid water on its surface.
If you jumped on the Moon, you would bounce about six times higher than on Earth because the Moon's gravitational pull is much weaker.
Earth's geographic North Pole is actually a magnetic south pole, which is why the north end of a compass needle is attracted to it.
A single lightning bolt contains enough electrical energy to toast approximately one hundred thousand slices of bread.
Light from the Sun takes about eight minutes to reach Earth, meaning you always see our star exactly as it looked eight minutes ago.
Sound travels nearly five times faster in water than in air because liquid water molecules are packed much more closely together than gas molecules.
The Sun's core is so incredibly hot that hydrogen atoms smash together to form helium, releasing massive amounts of heat and light energy.
A roller coaster at the top of its highest hill possesses maximum potential energy, which rapidly converts into kinetic energy as it plunges downward.
The threads on a metal screw act like an inclined plane wrapped around a cylinder, multiplying a small turning force into a massive forward push.
Honey has much higher fluid friction, or viscosity, than water, which is why it pours so much slower from a glass bottle.
An electromagnet only produces a magnetic field when electrical current flows through its wire coils, allowing giant cranes to drop heavy scrap metal on command.
